locations.tag_prompt: underwater, coral reef, light rays, clear water, fish, bubbles
locations.desc_en: Clear tropical coral sea, sunbeams shining through the water and drawing light patterns on the sandy bottom.

locations.tag_prompt: underwater, cave, glowing coral, shipwreck, throne, dark, bioluminescence
locations.desc_en: An underwater cave full of glowing corals, a throne made from an old shipwreck in the middle.

panels.scene_en: a crystal clear coral reef with sunbeams shining through the water, colorful fish, no people
Maja swims underwater with snorkel and fins, pointing towards a dark cave, while the sea otter does a somersault next to her holding a glowing blue pearl

bubbles.speaker: maja
bubbles.text: Perličko, podívej! Tam odtud vychází to divné světlo.

panels.scene_en: the little sea otter holds up a glowing blue pearl like a lantern towards the cave, blowing bubbles
inside an underwater cave full of glowing corals, a big old octopus sits on a throne made from a shipwreck
the big wise octopus crosses several tentacles and looks down sternly

bubbles.speaker: straz
bubbles.text: Kdo se odvažuje vstoupit do Jeskyně vzpomínek?

panels.scene_en: the sea otter carefully places her glowing pearl in front of the octopus as a gift, Maja points at the otter and smiles

bubbles.speaker: maja
bubbles.text: Jsme kamarádky! Hledáme ztracenou hvězdu z oceánské koruny!

panels.scene_en: the old octopus smiles and raises one tentacle in welcome, the otter beams

bubbles.speaker: straz
bubbles.text: Vydra s tak čistým srdcem tu dlouho nebyla. Vstupte!
